summary: Backend bot-fix validation (iteration 232). 10/10 pytest tests passed. Verified: (a) name-based info queries trigger customers.search, (b) operation detail queries trigger operations.search, (c) alerts query correctly triggers firewall.top_alerts (NOT operations.search), (d) integrity queries trigger firewall.operation_integrity, (e) smart fallback on proper Arabic names triggers both customers.search + operations.search, (f) /api/runtime/execute with 'احذفها' + proposer='مدير' returns status='pending_approval' via Four-Eyes (delete_operation), (g) create_customer returns 'committed', (h) customer 'محمد الجهني ابو خالد' (phone 0505172748) is found in matches.

minor.issue: Response is wrapped in {success, data:{...}} envelope — clients (incl. frontend AssistantProvider) must unwrap. Confirm frontend handles this consistently.

action_items: Verify frontend AssistantProvider correctly unwraps the {success, data} envelope from /api/assistant/chat (the data object now contains tool_results, response, cards, mode).
Consider documenting the response envelope shape in the API docs to prevent client confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: assistant_kernel._TOOL_PATTERNS — the 'firewall.top_alerts' regex now includes 'تحذير(ات)' and 'التنبي'. Good. Verify these don't accidentally match operational queries that should hit operations.search (currently tested OK for 'ماهي العمليات والتحذيرات').

operations.search pattern uses lookahead exclusions (وال/والت/بدون/بلا/في\s/من\s) — robust but brittle. If a customer name starts with one of those particles it will fail. Edge case but worth a unit test set.

Smart fallback in detect_tools() runs only when NO patterns matched. If a name happens to contain a stop-word like 'كم' (e.g., 'كمال أحمد'), the fallback may not trigger because 'كم' triggers nothing but the name pattern still matches — verify via additional test cases.

tool_router._operations_search() fetches up to 200 ops on every call (no caching). Combined with the 15s perf_cache TTL elsewhere, this is acceptable for now, but consider caching the /api/operations response or paging on the partner field server-side.

delete_operation action arrives with empty payload {} (no operation_id) — yet still returns pending_approval. The approval workflow MUST resolve the target operation from session context before commit, otherwise approval will commit an unscoped delete. Check action_runtime.commit() for delete_operation safety guard.
test_credentials: Admin proposer used: 'مدير' (name-only, no password) — passes Four-Eyes for risky actions.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 transient test customer with name 'TEST_احمد' via /api/runtime/execute (create_customer). Recommend cleanup by main agent if persistence to Supabase occurred.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bot fixes from iter232 validated end-to-end via public URL. The /api/assistant/chat envelope is {success: true, data: {...}} — tests must unwrap. For future iterations: test files live in /app/backend/tests/ and JUnit XMLs in /app/test_reports/pytest/. Bot routing now correctly distinguishes alerts/integrity/operations/customers by Arabic intent.
rca of the issue: N/A — fixes are working. Initial test-script issue was forgetting to unwrap the {success, data} response envelope; fixed in test and all 10 cases pass.
